load.risk.ariaNow: ACWR {value}, higher injury risk. What does this mean?
load.explainer.title: Training load, briefly
load.explainer.intro: Load = RPE × minutes. ACWR = your last week against your last four weeks. 1.0 means as much as you are used to.
load.explainer.riskSummary: In team sports, injuries became much more likely once the ratio rose above about 1.5. The lowest risk was between 0.8 and 1.3.
load.explainer.jumps: Risk climbs with sudden jumps: a much bigger week than the one before, or full training right after a break. Building up step by step keeps the ratio in the sweet spot.
load.explainer.caveat: An indicator, not a prediction: the ratio alone cannot tell whether one person gets injured. How you feel counts too.
